checks.label: Tanks match the engine's propellants
checks.detail: OXT holds oxygen, FUT holds ethanol.

checks.label: Site ambient pressure
checks.detail: 94.07 kPa at 627 m. Layer X reports absolute pressures; gauge readings are referenced to 101.325 kPa, as on the DAQ.

checks.label: Feed-line heights
checks.detail: LOX: 0.14 m of line from the tank, falls 0.00 m (no height on the drawing); Fuel: 0.96 m of line from the tank, falls 0.00 m (no height on the drawing). In flight a line with no height carries no head; only the tank's own liquid feels the acceleration. Put the heights on the drawing in pid-designer, or restate each line's elevation_change under Enter measured values.

checks.label: Regulator dome setting
checks.detail: 513.6 psig on the control regulator gives 578.0 psia tank lockup with the bottle at 4500 psig.

checks.label: Vessel ratings
checks.detail: Estimated, not measured or from a datasheet: TK-LOX 1000 psi, TK-FUEL 1000 psi, COPV-GN2 6750 psi. The MAWP checks and the optimiser's tank-pressure ceiling stand on these.

checks.label: GN2 on a cold LOX tank
checks.detail: At 578 psia the LOX tank's pressurant use is set by the cold wall the gas meets (the wall uncovered as LOX drains, and the upper wall chilled during loading), not by condensation on the liquid (grams). With the tank wall unmodelled, LOX-side gas use reads low: estimated +7 % with a warm upper wall to +60 % with one at 120-150 K. A full bottle still holds lockup; do not fill it short until bottle use has been measured on a firing.

checks.label: Oxidiser load fits
checks.detail: 6.611 kg fills 38 % of the 15.10 L tank.

checks.label: Fuel load fits
checks.detail: 4.404 kg fills 64 % of the 8.67 L tank.

checks.label: Oxidiser tank volume: drawing vs config
checks.detail: The drawing's tank is 15.10 L; the config's is 6.44 L. The burn follows the drawing. A different ullage is a different blowdown.

checks.label: Fuel tank volume: drawing vs config
checks.detail: The drawing's tank is 8.67 L; the config's is 6.20 L. The burn follows the drawing. A different ullage is a different blowdown.

checks.label: Main valves bound to the Fire state
checks.detail: Fuel Main → MVF, LOX Main → MVO

checks.label: Engine card from EngineDesign
checks.detail: 273 EngineDesign solves at the line exit (numba chamber kernel, 1.0 s). The table reproduces EngineDesign's own model to Pc 0.02 %, thrust 0.02 %, flow 0.03 % on 40 held-out solves (tolerance 0.2 %; whole scan Pc 0.1 %). That is agreement with the model, not accuracy: the model's own unknowns (Cd, mixing, nozzle efficiency) are the uncertainty sweep's.

checks.label: Engine boundary at the line exit
checks.detail: Line exit to chamber at T-0: LOX 157.7 psi, fuel 157.7 psi, EngineDesign's exit dump into the manifold included. The drawing's lines carry everything upstream; EngineDesign's own feed_system K is not used.

checks.label: Propellant density: EngineDesign vs feed model
checks.detail: oxidiser 1140.0 vs 1142.1 kg/m³ (+0.2 %); fuel 789.0 vs 789.3 kg/m³ (+0.0 %). The engine card is tabulated at EngineDesign's densities; flow scales with √ρ, so the flow error is half the density gap.

checks.label: Unspecified drawing parameters
checks.detail: 67 library default(s), 125 assumed value(s) in total; listed under Details.

checks.label: Burn ends with the tanks empty
checks.detail: The burn ends when the first tank is down to 1 g: burnt dry. No unusable residual (sump, line, pull-through) is stated; enter a measured one to charge for it.

notes: Pressurant flown at the twin's T-0 bottle mass, 1.454 kg (the config's sizing says 1.312 kg).
COPV of 4.69 L flown with its structure scaled by volume from the config's 4.62 L: 3.24 kg (estimate).
fuel tank runs dry at t=3.4651 s of a 3.4663 s curve; thrust and both flows stop there.
rocket.rocket_length 6.433 m, but the stack flown is 7.757 m tail to nose tip (tank positions + avionics_payload_length_m); drag and inertia use the stack

truncation.message: fuel tank runs dry at t=3.4651 s of a 3.4663 s curve; thrust and both flows stop there.

basis.diameter: the airframe's 156.7 mm body (rocket.radius): the chamber's 165.1 mm OD is wider than any motor mount OpenRocket will accept
basis.length: injector face to nozzle exit (80 % bell), as Layer 1 measures it

feed_fit.basis: In flight: every liquid column at the flight's acceleration. Settled firing steps (63, from 0.3 s after Fire, last step left out), against the design's velocity head (its density, its A_hydraulic). Fit again after the injector is resized: the supply term is exact only at the flow it was fitted at.

engine_check.basis: EngineDesign's coupled time-varying solve (ablative and graphite recession on) at the line-exit pressures the twin delivered, at each instant. Thrust on the Layer X side is the card's at its as-built nozzle; the delivered thrust is EngineDesign's.

cross_check.basis: EngineDesign's forward solve at Layer X's tank pressures at this instant, through its own feed_system K; Layer X through the drawing's lines. Line exit is the pressure where the feed line meets the injector, before the dump into the manifold, in both columns. The engine itself is the same in both (see the engine check), so a difference here is the feed lines.
